title: Expensive work during app startup
summary: Flask application startup performs network calls, migrations, model loading, or large filesystem scans.
rationale: Heavy startup work slows deploys, autoscaling, and cold starts, increasing idle compute and recovery time.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Move expensive setup to build time, lazy initialization, warmup jobs, or explicitly bounded startup hooks.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
